item.title: India’s First Rail-Road Tunnel in Assam Aimed at Securing Northeast in Case of War, Says CM Sarma
item.description: GUWHATI: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma on Sunday, February 15 said the Gohpur–Numaligarh rail-cum-road tunnel under the Brahmaputra is being developed keeping strategic considerations in mind, particularly to ensure connectivity within Assam and the wider Northeast in emergency situations. item.title: Modi to Lay Foundation Stone for Silchar–Shillong–Guwahati High Speed Corridor During Third Assam Visit This Year
item.description: GUWAHATI: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to visit Assam in March to lay the foundation stone for the Silchar–Shillong–Guwahati High-Speed Corridor, marking his third visit to the state this year. The visit will focus on launching one of the largest highway infrastructure projects currently being undertaken in the country. item.description: GUWAHATI: The ropeway project to Kamakhya Temple is set to move forward, with the Assam government announcing that the bidding process will be finalised within the next few days.
